name: Suzuka Kazuma
source:
Suzuka is a typical jock. From the beginning of the first year he's a regular at the basketball club and his dream is to go to America on a basketball scholarship. He is very talented, but has a hard time playing as part of a team. He takes afterschool lessons together with Kijou Madoka and sometimes plays video games with Morimura.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
Suzuka is a typical jock. From the beginning of the first year he's a regular at the basketball club and his dream is to go to America on a basketball scholarship. He is very talented, but has a hard time playing as part of a team. He takes afterschool lessons together with Kijou Madoka and sometimes plays video games with Morimura.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side]Wikipedia[/url]]
